annotations.title: Lire une annonce / Read a listing

description: Read one listing or adoptable animal in full after a search, by the id or url from chercher_annonces, chercher_par_photo or chercher_adoptions. Returns description, marks, dates, source, photos and sightings, or temperament, health and fee. Never returns contact details. Accepts French or English; replies in French, or English with langue "en".

annonce.description: Listing or adoptable animal to read (string): the id or url returned by chercher_annonces, chercher_par_photo or chercher_adoptions, e.g. "3f2b9c1e-5d4a-4b8e-9c7f-1a2b3c4d5e6f" or "https://missionmuseaux.fr/fiches/<id>".

langue.description: Response language: "fr" (French, default) or "en" (English). A request written in English is answered in English even without it.

name: voir_annonce

couleur.description: Listing colour, translated into the response language when it is in the colour vocabulary, otherwise as written.

criteres_demandes.description: For each criterion of the request (breed, colour, sex, age, gets-on-with), whether the record states it. Empty when no such criterion was asked.

precise.description: true when the record states this criterion (and matches it); false when it does not say, so it is kept as a possible match.

description_auteur.description: “Mission Museaux” when the listing text is a summary written by Mission Museaux from the original listing (a rewording, not a quotation); null when it is the listing's own text, quoted.

mise_a_jour_le.description: Listing: the latest of its last sighting, last status change and derniere_nouvelle, so it can be later than in search results. Animal offered by another association: when that association last changed its listing, null when unknown. ISO date.

publiee_le.description: When the record was first published (ISO date): on Mission Museaux, at the original platform for a reprise, or by the association offering the animal. null when unknown.

source.description: Where the record comes from: mission_museaux (published on Mission Museaux), reprise (a listing relayed from another platform, not named; contact goes through the original listing) or association_partenaire (an animal offered by another French association or shelter, not registered on Mission Museaux, whose listing Mission Museaux relays).

verifiee_le.description: When Mission Museaux last re-read the listing of the association offering the animal and found it still listed (ISO date); a freshness check, not a verification of the animal. null for Mission Museaux's own animals.

title: Lire une annonce / Read a listing
